verdict.rationale: Apify's web-scraper Actor supports startUrls with maxCrawlPages, enabling full-site crawling from a single API call, and Actors like Crawlee-based scrapers are designed for whole-site crawling with recursive link following. The client examples show a single call('apify/web-scraper', {startUrls, maxCrawlPages}) request returning crawled results, matching the 'one request' story. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on benchmark of crawl completeness or scale reliability across large sites, and no explicit doc excerpt describing link-following/pagination logic beyond maxCrawlPages parameter.
